status: Data preparation only; no model, imputation, or risk labels fitted
sampling: Preserve original 16 and add 13 without replacement from the remaining 423 assessed participants; no balancing by retinal result or filtering by optional-field completeness
scope: Declare this a 29-person demonstration subset of a larger dataset.
The earlier 16 people's three measurements are preserved unchanged.
All available fields for the same person are linked by public source ID.
The source contains only two recorded sex/gender categories, not all gender identities.
Optional-field availability does not prove additional eye-risk usefulness.
Retinal outcomes, identifiers, and survey weights are excluded from model inputs.
Age scope is 40-79; diabetes type is unverified; future quality-of-life decline is not measured.
This is not a nationally representative sample or calibrated individual risk model.
